channel.title: Ryan J Hamby
channel.description: Software engineer working on AI compute, from the serving layer to the hardware: vLLM and Firecracker contributions, GPU telemetry, Rust and low-latency C++.

item.title: Kubernetes' Second Act: From Container Orchestrator to AI Operating System
item.description: Why Kubernetes never left, and how it became the default substrate for running AI inference workloads.

item.title: Optical Cables and Multicast: Why Your Network Hardware Matters More Than You Think
item.description: How fiber optics impact TCP/UDP multicast speeds, and which cables actually optimize for low-latency group communication.

item.title: Cache Eviction: 30 Years of Improvements
item.description: How cache hierarchies and eviction policies evolved over three decades, from simple in-memory buffers to modern tiered caches, and what the data says about their effectiveness.
